rules: The episode box holds every tranche when a coincident and a lead cluster both vote (a strict majority of their live members — see Episode gates), or when a hy_oas / ccc_bb / private_credit / earnings / tech_lead sign row blocks; below quorum (70 % of members live) T2/T3 hold too. The trend gate holds every tranche while SXR8 closes below a falling 200-day. A gate on an unread feed reads n/a and holds. The gates and the time stop are price facts — never act on an open; the close decides. IG OAS and QQQ/QQQE are display reads, never gates. The drawdown watch grades its measured rows only (HY · VIX · SPY trend · NFCI risk · claims), with or without a drawdown open; breadth, CCC−BB, earnings, private credit and the Fed path show their lean and never grade, and claims never holds a re-entry tranche.

situation.lean: CALM: a shallow drawdown opened on 10-30, but the measured danger rows stay near their lows and the latest prints mostly cleared — the Fed held without guiding to a hike, Apple guided above expectations and the midterms gave a clean result the market rallied on. Credit is still the one grind and the AI-funding read has turned bear, so the tranches stay parked rather than bought back.
situation.slow: Junk spreads widened back toward their episode high after a brief late-October dip, the weakest tier sits far above its calm line and better-quality junk is back over its own. Private credit is soft only at the edges — Blue Owl's listed BDC took a marginal rise in bad loans with its book value up, and its non-traded funds again rationed redemptions — with Barings tonight and the BDC filings mid-month to come.
situation.fast: The gap risk now sits with the December Fed meeting, where futures price a hike as likely, and with NVDA's results on 11-17 into a tape that just gave Alphabet its worst day on record despite higher spending. Payrolls on 11-06 and October CPI on 11-10 can move the hike odds within a day.
situation.decides: Payrolls on 11-06 and CPI on 11-10 move the Fed-path lean — a strong print firms the December hike, a soft one cools it — and NVDA on 11-17 moves the fast slot through the AI-spend read. The French Assembly's first-reading deadline on the whole budget on 11-17, the S&P France review on 11-27 and the 12-09 FOMC with new dots are the next contagion and rates tests, the last two holding T2 and T3.
situation.flips: HY at or over its correction line together with SPX closing below its 200-day on 3 closes moves the watch to a correction grade; a December hike with higher 2027 dots, BB through 2.5 %, a BDC forced sale or a France downgrade adds to it. HY retracing toward its September lows with earnings estimates still rising keeps it calm.
